This deposit is non-refundable, but it will be applied toward the total cost of your service.
Weather-related cancellations can be rescheduled within one year of the original booking at no additional charge.
If you need to cancel or reschedule your appointment, we require at least 14 days' notice.
Cancellations Within 14 Days: If you cancel or reschedule within 14 days of your scheduled appointment, you forfeit the $100 deposit.
